name: Wansford Old Bridge

layers.essential_history: [[c:The stone bridge carried the Great North Road over the Nene. It replaced an eight-arch wooden bridge damaged by floods in 1571. A post halfway across marks the old border between Northamptonshire and Huntingdonshire.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The bridge is Grade I listed. Since the 1920s a concrete bridge has carried the northbound A1 nearby.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Halfway across, by the county post, there are cart marks and a scrape of red paint, the colour of the London coach.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The boundary post]]
material: [[c:On one side of the post is Northamptonshire, on the other Huntingdonshire.]]
[[c:The cart marks start on the inn side and stop at the post.]]
[[c:The scrape of red paint is on the Northamptonshire side.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:On which county's side did the cart stop? (county)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Northamptonshire. Someone wheeled the box to the middle of the bridge and stopped on the Northamptonshire side.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:The box was wheeled to the middle of the bridge.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head west to the water meadows, about 320 metres along the route. Follow the line on the map, and keep to pavements and public paths.]]
